headline: Huawei Convicted in US on Multiple Criminal Counts Over Iran Business
summary: A US jury convicted Huawei and three subsidiaries on 10 criminal counts, including bank fraud, money laundering, and sanctions violations related to business dealings in Iran.
why: Criminal convictions of major multinational technology corporations carry severe financial penalties, compliance restrictions, and geopolitical ramifications.

impacts.name: Huawei
impacts.why: Criminal convictions for fraud and sanctions violations expose the firm to severe legal and financial penalties.
